name: print_timeline
description: Print the timeline as its literal TSX projection (header with media table, pending count and rev, then <track> and item elements, one per line). Always print before editing; use from/lines to read part of a long timeline.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: apply_timeline
description: Apply an edit to the timeline as one undoable revision. Give `edits` (each oldText must occur exactly once in the printed timeline of `rev`; newText replaces it; empty newText deletes) with the `rev` from the header you edited, or a whole replacement `source`. Edits the person made meanwhile are merged. Returns what changed, conflicts and warnings, or the diagnostics that refused the edit.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: The rev from the printed header the edits were made against

edits.description: Text edits against the printed timeline

source.description: Complete replacement projection text (instead of edits)

prefer.description: Which side wins a conflict with edits the person made meanwhile (default file)

name: verify_timeline
description: Report problems: overlapping items, gaps on the main track, clips running past their source, missing or offline media, pending placeholders.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: undo_timeline
description: Undo your most recent change that is not undone yet (or your revision `rev`) as a new revision. Only your own changes are undone; edits the person or other agents made meanwhile stay. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: One of your revisions to undo (default: your latest)

name: list_media
description: The project's media: id, name (usable as src), kind, duration, online/offline status and use count.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: add_media
description: Add files to a project by absolute path: each is probed, registered and placed as a clip (video/images on Main, audio on Audio, after the last clip unless `at` is given).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

at.description: Start of the first clip in seconds

name: seek
description: Move the app's playhead to a time in seconds so the person sees that moment.

name: check_code
description: Check a code item's composition before (or after) applying it: transpiles the TSX, reports syntax errors, imports and unavailable globals with line:column, then renders frames at the start, middle and end and reports runtime errors, endless loops, unsupported elements and styles, console output and the slowest frame time. Pass the codeComposition object ({source, props?, assets?} or {template, props}).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: ask_user
description: Ask the person a question when a choice is genuinely theirs (style, which take, what to cut). Offer 2-4 short options when you can. Blocks until they answer.

name: undo_my_changes
description: Undo every change of this session (scope session, the default) or of one turn (scope turn) as one new revision, keeping everyone else's edits. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change by someone else touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

turn.description: The turn id (default: the current turn)
